zero_omission_notes.summary: Explores magnetic field lines, Oersted's discovery, Right-Hand Thumb Rule, circular loops, solenoids, electromagnets, Fleming's Left-Hand Rule, electric motor principle, domestic circuits (live, neutral, earth wires), fuse protection, and short-circuiting.

detailed_sections.full_notes: Magnetic field is a vector quantity with direction from North to South outside magnet. Field lines form continuous closed loops and never intersect.

margin_notes_and_sidebars.title: Right-Hand Thumb Rule
margin_notes_and_sidebars.content: Point thumb along current direction; curled fingers give direction of surrounding magnetic field lines.

practical_lab_activity_or_methodology_ma.aim_or_objective: To trace magnetic field line pattern around a bar magnet using iron filings.
procedure_or_steps: Place bar magnet under cardboard sheet.
Sprinkle iron filings evenly using shaker.
practical_lab_activity_or_methodology_ma.observations_or_results: Iron filings align in curved lines emerging from North pole and entering South pole.
practical_lab_activity_or_methodology_ma.conclusion_or_principle: Visualizes magnetic field lines showing maximum field strength near poles.

diagrams_figures_and_maps.drawing_or_reading_instructions: Draw 3 parallel line wires entering house through fuse and meter to supply appliance sockets.
diagrams_figures_and_maps.structural_or_conceptual_explanation: Earth wire connects metallic casing of appliances to ground for shock protection.

master_glossary_units_and_formulas.definition_or_meaning: A long cylindrical coil of many tightly wound insulated copper wire turns that generates a uniform magnetic field similar to a bar magnet when current flows.
master_glossary_units_and_formulas.example_or_application: Inserting a soft iron core inside forms an Electromagnet.

master_glossary_units_and_formulas.definition_or_meaning: Stretch Thumb, Forefinger, and Middle finger mutually perpendicular: Forefinger = Magnetic Field, Middle finger = Current, Thumb = Force/Motion direction.
master_glossary_units_and_formulas.si_unit_or_notation: F = B x I x L (Force on current carrying conductor in magnetic field).
master_glossary_units_and_formulas.example_or_application: Determines rotation direction of electric motor armature.

textbook_exercises.question: Which of the following correctly describes the magnetic field near a long straight wire?
textbook_exercises.answer: Field consists of concentric circles centered on the wire. Option (d) is correct.

objective_questions_1_mark.question: Which rule determines direction of magnetic field around a straight current conductor?
objective_questions_1_mark.explanation: Thumb along current gives curled finger direction of magnetic field lines.

short_answer_questions.question: Why do two magnetic field lines never intersect each other?
short_answer_questions.answer: If two field lines intersected at a point, a compass needle placed at that intersection would point in two different directions simultaneously, which is physically impossible.

analytical_reasoning_questions.question: What happens to circuit resistance and current during a short circuit?
analytical_reasoning_questions.answer: Resistance drops almost to zero and current increases abruptly to a dangerously high level, causing sparks/fire.

comprehensive_long_answers.question: Explain working principle of an Electric Motor with labeled diagram.
comprehensive_long_answers.answer: Principle: A current-carrying coil placed in a magnetic field experiences a mechanical force causing rotation (Fleming's Left-Hand Rule). Construction: Rectangular armature coil ABCD between magnet poles N-S, connected to split-ring commutator segments P-Q and carbon brushes X-Y. Working: Current in arm AB flows A->B (force downwards); current in CD flows C->D (force upwards), forming anti-clockwise torque. Split-ring reverses current direction every half rotation, ensuring continuous uni-directional rotation.

competency_and_case_studies.case_scenario: A 5kW electric oven is connected to a 220V domestic circuit equipped with a 5A fuse.

qa.question: What will happen when the oven is switched on?
qa.answer: Current drawn I = P / V = 5000 W / 220 V = 22.7 A. Since 22.7 A exceeds the 5 A fuse rating, the fuse wire will melt and break the circuit to prevent fire.

common_misconceptions_and_pitfalls.common_error_or_misconception: Confusing Fleming's Left-Hand Rule (Motors) with Right-Hand Thumb Rule (Field direction).
common_misconceptions_and_pitfalls.correct_fact_or_method: Use Left-Hand for Force/Motion in Electric Motors; Right-Hand Thumb for Magnetic Field lines around wires.
